verdict.rationale: Sonar API is primarily a web-grounded search/answer API; the only capability that touches 'my data' is the embeddings endpoint for building RAG pipelines over custom data (docs-3), which requires the developer to build the insight layer rather than the API itself generating suggestions from a user's existing data inside a product. Missing for 10: any native feature that ingests and surfaces insights from a user's own stored data, first-party product UI showing such suggestions, and evidence of this working end-to-end rather than as a raw building block.
